title: Agent Workshop event (v1)
description: Canonical, framework-neutral event emitted by adapters and streamed by the bridge to the game client. Unknown event types are allowed: clients show a generic animation.

framework.description: Source framework, e.g. claude-code, opencode, pi, hermes.

agent.description: Agent id within the session. 'main' for the top-level agent.

type.description: Known: session_start, tool_start, tool_end, subagent_start, subagent_end, thinking, waiting_permission, error, done.

category.description: What a tool does. The only tool field the game uses to pick a station.

tool.description: Raw tool name, for tooltips and logs.

target.description: File, command, pattern or URL the tool acts on.

id.description: Tool call id (tool_start/tool_end) or subagent id (subagent_*).
